iniconfig_consumer.probe_source:
from iniconfig._parse import UTF8_BOM, parse_ini_data

# These are synthetic config strings. The imported parser is exact upstream code.
assert UTF8_BOM == "\ufeff"
data = "[app]\nname = café\ncount: 7\n"
plain_sections, plain_sources = parse_ini_data(
    "synthetic.ini", data, strip_inline_comments=False
)
bom_sections, bom_sources = parse_ini_data(
    "synthetic.ini", "\ufeff" + data, strip_inline_comments=False
)
assert plain_sections == bom_sections
assert plain_sources == bom_sources
assert bom_sections["app"]["name"] == "café"
assert bom_sections["app"]["count"] == "7"
assert bom_sources[("app", None)] == 0
assert bom_sources[("app", "name")] == 1
assert bom_sources[("app", "count")] == 2
print("BOM", len(UTF8_BOM), ascii(UTF8_BOM))
print("config", bom_sections["app"]["name"], bom_sections["app"]["count"])
print("sources", bom_sources[("app", None)], bom_sources[("app", "name")],
      bom_sources[("app", "count")])
